facts.text: Select Environments, choose environment to copy, select Copy, specify new environment name and type, then confirm.
Copied environment uses same application version; includes all per-tenant and Marketplace extensions from original environment.
Linked Power Platform environment is not copied; newly created environment will not be linked to any Power Platform environment.
Sandbox with Preview version Marketplace apps cannot copy to production; update to public version or uninstall first.
New environment initially shows Preparing status, then Active when fully operational; original environment remains active.
